quest:Dazey1.name: Dressing_like_a_Dork
quest:Dazey1.description: Help Dazey build a Sprout costume. You don't actually need a pea brain, that was just her being a jerk.

quest:Dazey2.name: Literally_Physics
quest:Dazey2.description: Get some woodular circles from branches, and do something with them? I don't go to Dazey's school either, I'm as confused as you are.

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!

item:Quest41.name: Flowies
item:Quest41.description: Curse you flowey! I trusted you, I accepted your pellets of friendship, and then you had to go and throw it all away! And now here you are, trying to take over yet another video game... well I NOT GONNA LE-- oh wait, these are just normal flowers

item:NPCtoken14.name: Dazey_Token
item:NPCtoken14.description: Proof that you completed all of Dazey's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM

item:ExpBalloon2.name: Medium_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon2.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:TreeInterior1b.name: Woodular_Circle
item:TreeInterior1b.description: Made of circle that's been carved into the shape of a wood. NOTE: This is a very rare drop from Branches

pageProps.seoDescription: Dazey is a Legends of Idleon NPC: quest reward, 2 quests.
